title: RLFTSim: Realistic and Controllable Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning

control_signal.value: Per-agent goal point (soft pass target or hard reach target); an agent can be left unconditioned for hybrid conditioned/unconditioned simulation.

control_mechanism.value: Goal-conditioned fine-tuning with REINFORCE: goal given by concatenation to agent token embedding or binary goal indication in relative positional encoding; reward mixes realism MLOO and goal-reaching with weight lambda; hindsight experience replay.

base_model.value: Pretrained SMART-tiny next-token prediction model, with KL control to the reference model; also applied to TrafficBots V1.5 (VAE-based).

datasets.value: Waymo Open Motion Dataset, with WOSAC benchmark evaluation.

metrics.value: Realism meta-metric RMM plus kinematic, interactive, map-based components; collision, off-road, ADE, minADE; goal reach rate and pass rate.

controllability_evidence.value: Goal completion: reference SMART-tiny reaches 35.37% and passes 42.89%; RLFTSim (cat, hard) reaches 50.00%, (cat, soft) passes 75.34%.

stated_limitations.value: Half-second token chunks may reduce responsiveness; goal-conditioned fine-tuning gives reasonable but imperfect controllability; RMM is only a proxy for realism and may saturate.

notes: Controllability covers goal conditioning only; the main-text Table 3 is not in packet (appendix table used).
